recordedNonDefects.observation: Space preset sizes multiply by density once and by rhythm once, which is correct and is NOT the double-scaling Stack had to avoid. The reason is that --ds-space-small-size, --ds-space-middle-size and --ds-space-large-size are declared as fixed rems in presentation/components/space.css and are NOT rungs on the density-scaled --ds-spacing-* ramp, so they carry no embedded density factor. Stack is the inverse case: --ds-spacing-N already embeds density, which is why Stack must not re-multiply.

The preset rule's innermost var() fallback terminal is --ds-spacing-2, which IS density-scaled. If that arm ever fired, density would apply twice. It is currently unreachable because the engine writes --ds-space-instance-gap unconditionally and --ds-space-small-size is declared at :root.
A tenant that overrides the compat alias --ds-space-small-size with a --ds-spacing-* value would import a second density factor through its own authoring.
